one_liner: CameraManagerTest is a demo app that showcases multiple camera modes (default, follow, orbit, static) with interactive key controls and a UI overlay.
primary_use_case: Allows developers to test and demo camera behaviors (follow, orbit, shake) on moving cubes within a Hyperfy world.
preview_recommendation: The preview video clearly demonstrates the C/O/Z key controls, camera mode switching, and cube animations, making it a useful visual reference for developers.
